# v0.24.8

## Changes (English)

- Share the Code tab's conversation list in environments created with "Separate the account only" (#234). The Desktop app keeps that list in a folder named after the signed-in account, so CSW links it to your Existing Claude's list on the next launch after you sign in and open the Code tab, or right away with csw doctor --fix. A list the environment had built before is kept aside under a name ending in .csw-local, and the isolation check reports the list as its 13th item.
- Duplicating an environment no longer fails when it contains nested symbolic links. Links are skipped at every depth, and the duplicate links the shared conversation list again.
